requirements.text: By default, the source generator tests must compile the test input and the generated code at C# 7.3, the language version a netstandard2.0 project uses by default (issue #1925), so generated code that needs a newer language version fails the tests.

claude.basis: Both the Test.LanguageVersion property and the RunDefaultAsync parameter default to CSharp7_3, the value is applied to the parse options, and the regression check shows generated code failing with CS8370 at 7.3 on the pre-fix generator.

findings.title: Two generic-constraint tests pin C# 9 although their input uses C# 8 features
findings.claim: Generics_Constraints_NullableReferenceType and Generics_Constraints_ReferenceType_Nullable use #nullable enable / nullable constraints (C# 8) but are pinned to C# 9, so C# 9-only syntax emitted by the generator for these constraint shapes would not be caught. I did not run them at C# 8, so whether 8 suffices is unverified.
findings.suggested_fix: Try LanguageVersion.CSharp8 for these two tests and keep the lowest version that compiles the input.

findings.title: CSharpSourceGeneratorCodeFixVerifier default changed but the verifier is unused
findings.claim: No test class aliases CSharpSourceGeneratorCodeFixVerifier (I checked every VerifyCS alias at head), so this one-line change has no effect today; harmless and consistent, but it is not exercised by the suite.

evidence.quote: public LanguageVersion LanguageVersion { get; set; } = LanguageVersion.CSharp7_3;

findings.title: Test name does not match its source
findings.claim: CustomStringKeyFormatterTests.RecordWithWithInitOnlyProps is named for init-only properties (a C# 9 feature) but its source uses { get; set; } auto-properties and calls RunDefaultAsync without a language version, so it runs at the default C# 7.3 and does not exercise init-only properties.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the test, or change the properties to `init` accessors and pass languageVersion: LanguageVersion.CSharp9 so the test actually covers the feature its name promises.
